answer: The garden registers every clone as a nadir, one fake identity per slot. Every admission expires all live slots; each clone then rebinds its slot by burning one willow. Registering the kth nadir costs the attacker k willow, and parallel submissions replay every expiry, so N clones cost \(N(N+1)/2\) willow and cannot be split. If admission can batch without expiring slots, the defence breaks.
